units.source_text: 乐队于未时来到，奏出《万岁乐》《皇麞》等舞曲。

en.t: The musicians arrived at the Hour of the Goat and played dances such as Manzairaku and Ojō.

units.source_text: 日暮时分，奏出高丽笛曲，表演《落蹲》舞。

en.t: At dusk they played music for the Korean flute and performed the Rakuson dance.

units.source_text: 这也是寻常难得听到的舞乐。

en.t: This too was court music and dance that one could rarely hear in ordinary times.

units.source_text: 因此到了将近结束之时，中纳言夕雾和卫门督柏木都来参与，

en.t: So, when the performance was nearly over, the Middle Counselor Yugiri and the Captain of the Gate Guards Kashiwagi both joined in,

units.source_text: 舞罢将归，重又回步，另演新姿片刻，然后隐入红叶林中。

en.t: and after finishing the dance and seeming about to withdraw, they turned back, showed another fresh figure for a while, and then vanished into the grove of autumn leaves.

units.source_text: 观众深感兴趣，看到临去时的面影，大有尚未餍足之感。

en.t: The spectators were deeply enchanted, and the parting glimpse of them left everyone feeling far from satisfied.

units.source_text: 席上有许多人回想起当年桐壶帝行幸朱雀院时源氏公子与头中将共舞《青海波》那天傍晚的光景。

en.t: Many people present recalled the evening long ago when Emperor Kiritsubo visited the Suzaku Palace and Prince Genji danced Seigaiha together with the Captain.

units.source_text: 他们觉得夕雾与柏木都克肖其父，绝不逊色。

en.t: They felt that Yugiri and Kashiwagi closely resembled their fathers and were in no way inferior to them.

units.source_text: 两人的声名、容姿和性情也都不亚于其父，官位且比父亲当年稍高，年龄亦与两父亲当年相似。

en.t: In reputation, appearance, and character, the two were no less than their fathers; their ranks were even slightly higher than their fathers had held then, and their ages were much the same as their fathers had been at that time.

units.source_text: 因此他们都赞叹：定是前世积德，所以两代都是良朋。

en.t: So everyone exclaimed that surely they had accumulated virtue in former lives, for two generations had been blessed with such fine friendship.

units.source_text: 主人源氏也感慨流泪，回想起许多往事。

en.t: Their host Genji too was moved to tears as many memories of the past returned to him.

units.source_text: 天色将黑，乐队要退出了，

en.t: As the sky was growing dark and the musicians were about to withdraw,

units.source_text: 紫夫人的家臣长官便率领众人，走到盛犒赏品的柜子旁边，

en.t: the chief of Lady Murasaki's attendants led the others over to the stand where the gifts of reward had been laid out,

units.source_text: 将物品取出，一一赏赐乐人。

en.t: took out the items, and bestowed them one by one on the musicians.

units.source_text: 诸乐人肩上负着主人所赐的白绸，绕过假山，经过湖堤退出，

en.t: The musicians carried the white silk given by their host on their shoulders, circled around the artificial hill, and withdrew along the lake embankment,

units.source_text: 远远望去，教人错认是催马乐中所歌的千龄仙鹤的羽衣。

en.t: and from far away one might have mistaken it for the feather robes of the thousand-year cranes sung of in saibara songs.
